evaluations.model_answer: The trend line for 2024 shows a downward trend in the second half of the year.
evaluations.judge_reasoning: The model incorrectly described the non-existent trend line as if it exists and provided an analysis of its trend, failing to acknowledge that the element is not present in the chart.
